text: tena saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti . aññātaṃ bhagavā aññātaṃ sugatāti . yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsīti . rūpañce bhante anuseti taṃ anumiyyati yaṃ anumiyyati tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati . vedanañce anuseti . saññañce anuseti . saṅkhāre ce anuseti . viññāṇañce anuseti taṃ anumiyyati yaṃ anumiyyati tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati . rūpañce bhante nānuseti na taṃ anumiyyati yaṃ
